references.text: The same context regarding the fire on the altar that must be kept burning
The commandment that the lamp in the tabernacle should burn continuously, a parallel image of eternal fire
The daily burnt offering that was to be offered morning and evening, requiring that the fire always remain lit
The ordinance concerning the continual burnt offering which presupposes an ever-burning fire
Fire from heaven fell upon the altar at the temple dedication, and the priests maintained this holy fire
A prophetic image of fire that is not extinguished, connected to God's judgment
Jesus uses the image of unquenchable fire in his teaching about judgment
God is described as a consuming fire, an eternal and inexhaustible power
